engines.name: Radar Engine
engines.contains: Collectors → raw → normalize → validate → history → scoring → delivery
engines.recommendation: Стабилизировать ingestion/normalization/scoring как отдельный reusable core.

engines.name: Payment / Credit Ledger
engines.contains: Packages, balance, usage, refunds, reversals, reconciliation, audit trail
engines.recommendation: Одна accounting-style ledger модель вместо отдельных балансов в каждом продукте.

engines.name: Analytics / Attribution
engines.contains: Events, goals, funnels, KPI, performance feedback, reporting
engines.recommendation: Единый event taxonomy + reusable dashboard layer.

engines.name: Notification / Telegram
engines.contains: Alerts, approvals, status notifications, bot delivery
engines.recommendation: Разделить transactional alerts, approval actions и digest delivery.

engines.name: Data Validation / Reconciliation
engines.contains: Completeness, validity, duplicates, balances, source-vs-derived checks
engines.recommendation: Сделать набор стандартных controls и evidence output.

engines.name: AI Analysis / Scoring
engines.contains: Classification, relevance, trend scoring, anomaly interpretation, recommendation
engines.recommendation: Отделить rule-based metrics от LLM interpretation.

engines.name: Approval / Workflow State Machine
engines.contains: Draft → review → approved → execution → published/released + blocked/rework
engines.recommendation: Общий state-machine pattern с immutable event log.

engines.name: Product Control / Handoff
engines.contains: Work/Codex/GitHub roles, AGENTS, HANDOFF, QA gates, release checklist
engines.recommendation: Стандартизировать template repository и definition of done.

engines.name: Identity / Consent / Access
engines.contains: User identity, contact ownership, consent, access levels
engines.recommendation: Не переносить бизнес-правила автоматически; reuse только identity/access primitives.

engines.name: Content Generation Pipeline
engines.contains: Research → script → assets → render → approve → publish → measure
engines.recommendation: Запустить один production vertical slice и измерить cost/content + lead impact.

engines.name: Calendar / Sharing
engines.contains: ICS/calendar insertion, event metadata, cross-platform share
engines.recommendation: Сделать только после подтверждения Event Radar demand.

engines.name: SEO / AEO / AI Visibility
engines.contains: Technical SEO, local SEO, schema, AI search visibility, measurement
engines.recommendation: Использовать Zvenigorod Beauty как reference implementation/eval site.

Для каждого engine: owner, consumers, API boundary, maturity, source of truth.

focus30.done: Один общий pipeline, два разных output-представления.

focus30.action: Стабилизировать event taxonomy и weekly review
focus30.done: Ключевые lead events подтверждены; еженедельный отчёт строится из реальных данных.
Список P0 product gaps + тесты + owner + source-of-truth закреплены.
